acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

currentValue().notice: Current total value (in USDC) of all assets held in the protocol.

deploy(uint256).notice: Atomic USDC-to-PAXG swap. Called by the vault once per execution cycle.         The entire amount is swapped in one transaction — no state persists between call and return.

lastPaxgPricePerUsdc().notice: Last observed PAXG-per-USDC price (1e18-scaled, PAXG per 1e6 USDC).         Set to 0 before any swap; used as the reference floor on subsequent swaps.         This is a simple last-price oracle — not a TWAP. Sufficient for testnet.         Production: replace with a 30-min TWAP from a Uniswap V3 pool.

minOutBps().notice: Minimum output as a fraction of expected PAXG out.         Default: 9900 = 99% (1% max slippage).

protocolName().notice: Human-readable protocol identifier, e.g. "Compound V3" or "Curve 3pool".

recall(uint256).notice: Return PAXG to the swap router, receive USDC back for the vault.         Also atomic — full exit in one transaction.

vault().notice: Address of the vault that owns this adapter (receives recalled funds).
